inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan’s refusal to rule out immigration enforcement at polling places is alarming. Asking what Democrats are “afraid of” turns a serious threat into a taunt: visible enforcement could intimidate immigrant communities and discourage people from participating in elections. The Trump administration’s inconsistent answers only deepen the concern. People should be able to vote without fearing that an encounter with immigration authorities is waiting nearby.
